title: Insomnia Disorder - BSV and Vocal Impact
content:
DOCUMENT TYPE: BSV / Vocal

BSV / VOCAL SIGNALS: High Arousal (hyperarousal, racing mind at bedtime) with Low-to-moderate Valence (frustration, worry about sleep). Chronic insomnia often produces daytime fatigue with low arousal + low valence (exhaustion). Voice may show tension, sighing, or effortful quality when describing sleep difficulty. Sleep deprivation can blunt prosody and increase irritability in speech.

PATIENT-LANGUAGE EXAMPLES: "I lie awake for hours worrying about not sleeping", "I feel like a zombie during the day", "My mind won't shut off at night".

COUNTER-SIGNALS / NEGATIONS: Sleeps well once asleep, no daytime impairment, symptoms resolve with simple sleep hygiene.

PROVENANCE: Sleep medicine literature on hyperarousal model of insomnia and vocal correlates of fatigue.
